question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Appease
solution:
The correct answer is: **Pacify**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Appease"** means to calm or pacify someone by meeting their demands or by soothing their emotions. (शांत करना / मनाना)

 
 
• **Example: **The manager tried to appease the angry customers by offering them a discount.
 
 
 
• **"Pacify"** is the correct synonym for "Appease," as it also means to calm, soothe, or bring peace to a situation or a person. (शांत करना)
 
 
• **Example: **The mother pacified the crying baby by singing a lullaby.
 
 
 
• Hence, **"Pacify"** is the most appropriate synonym for "Appease."

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Pacify**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Force **(बल): Physical strength or power used to compel someone to do something.

 
 
• **Example:** The police used force to control the unruly crowd.
 
 
 
• **Aggravate **(बिगाड़ना): To make a situation or condition worse.
 
 
• **Example: **His rude remarks only aggravated the tension during the meeting.
 
 
 
• **Appeal** (निवेदन): To make a serious or formal request for help, support, or a decision.
 
 
• **Example:** The charity made an appeal to the public for donations.
